_comment: Example Adapt Credit plans. This file is CONFIGURATION, not a price list: it ships
with no currency and no price, because those are the operator's commercial terms
and typing them for them is how a codebase starts asserting a price it cannot back.
Copy it, edit the copy, and point ADAPT_CREDIT_PLANS_PATH at it. Every quantity is
an integer; floats are rejected. 'learner_limit' is credits per learner per period,
0 meaning no per-learner cap. 'allow_negative' is false everywhere: a wallet stops
at zero unless an operator deliberately says otherwise.
Action names must exist in adapt.credits.plans.ACTIONS. Anything unmetered --
standard notes, existing material, exports, attempts, review -- is not a plan row
